frame.title: Humayun’s Tomb
frame.axis: +X approximately east along south lower platform; +Z south outward. Main south entrance at positiveZ.
frame.source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap same-ID named POI and platform, layered terrace/mausoleum/roof parts, inspected local exterior photographs.
frame.identityStatus: Named Humayun’s Tomb POI and lower platform share35184592474486. Main clipped mausoleum35184452529652, upper terrace35184885062649 and drum35184885087888 retained separately. Exclude gates, gardens and separate tombs.

frame.scope: Main mausoleum, raised terrace, white dome, corner chhatris and arched red-sandstone elevations; exclude separate garden tombs/gates, garden pools, trees, furnishings and navigable interiors.
limitations: Native vector parts are quantized and have incomplete/conflicting roof height tags; retain facts without treating28m mapped drum height as dome crown.
Photographic exterior interpretation with UNESCO42.5m crown control; exact crypt/floor levels, inlay motifs, unseen details and masonry not surveyed.
Dry datum and native frame signed before independent ground and before geometry. No terrain flattening or automatic footprint replacement.

limitation: Diagnostic only;not a classified bare-earth DTM or floor survey. No field or model/frame/reference changes.
